pattern.description: In the open Version 2 list (Working Budget, May Forecast) the cursor moves down so the hover highlight shifts to May Forecast, clicks, and the dropdown snaps shut with Version 2 now reading May Forecast.
pattern.why_premium: The selection lands on 'revise their forecasts' in the narration, and the short, visible hover-then-click keeps a real UI step legible without slowing the pace.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {y:'+=14', duration:0.3, ease:'power1.inOut'}); tl.set('.dropdown li', {className:'-=hover'}, '<0.15'); tl.set('.dropdown li.may', {className:'+=hover'}, '<'); tl.set('.dropdown', {autoAlpha:0}, '+=0.1'); tl.set('.version2 .value', {textContent:'May Forecast'}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [y0, y1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); hover row swaps at frame 4; dropdown opacity = frame >= clickFrame ? 0 : 1 (hard cut); label swap on the same frame; no spring.

notes: Twin of e054 (Version 1 selection). The close is a single-frame cut (one energy spike). The cursor also moves but has no candidate box and was not listed.
